entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Papyrus 73, designated by 𝔓73, is a copy of the New Testament in Greek. It is a papyrus manuscript of the Gospel of Matthew. The surviving texts of Matthew are verses 25:43; 26:2-3. The manuscript paleographically has been assigned to the 7th century. Papyrus 73 is a manuscript. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
